messages:
Nina (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we have a new manager starting Mon AM. Can we assemble a compact 'first 10 days' action grid that combines: 1) immediate setup items (accounts, laptop, access), 2) first-week agenda, and 3) high-level 30/60/90 expectations? Want something managers can hand to hires and managers can check off. @Priya can you draft?

Priya: Yep — I can. Thinking a two-column layout: 
- Left: day-by-day actions (who owns)
- Right: quick links & owners.
I can drop a plaintext checklist here for easy pasting into offer email.

Alex M: That'd be great. For engineering managers please include: dev repo access, CI/CD perms, pager onboarding, and first 1:1 template. Also a short note about who to ask for team infra (e.g., Sam for dev tools).

Priya: Draft below — feel free to edit. 
```
Day 0 (pre-start):
- HR packet & E-Signatures (People Ops)
- Order laptop + peripherals (IT)
- Invite to org-wide Slack + email alias (IT)

Day 1 AM:
- Welcome sync with manager (30m) (Manager)
- Team intros (15m) (Manager)
- Set up laptop, SSO login, MFA (IT)
- Add to team Google Drive / Confluence (People Ops)

Day 1 PM:
- Account access: GitHub org, CI, JIRA, Datadog, Redwood Console (Manager/Sam)
- 1:1 scheduling cadence & expectations (Manager)

Days 2-5:
- Deep-dive: product roadmap & architecture walkthroughs (Eng leads)
- Shadow customer sync / support triage (CS)
- Complete required security/compliance training (Security)
- Set up recurring 1:1s, skip-level intro (People Ops)

By Day 10:
- Manager to share 30/60/90 draft and top 3 priorities (Manager/New Hire)
- Assign a mentor / on-call buddy (Eng)

30/60/90 (one-paragraph each):
- 30d: Understand team goals, run first 1:1s, stabilize onboarding tasks.
- 60d: Own at least one delivery milestone, propose small ops improvements.
- 90d: Lead planning for next quarter, hire or resource asks ready.
```

Priya: I'll also add links to our templates (1:1, 30/60/90, risk register) and owners in Confluence.

Jordan (IT): FYI — laptop order for managers takes ~3 business days unless priority requested. To speed up, send `it-setup-bot` a 'priority' ticket. For access: create GitHub team membership request to `org-admins` with manager's email; tag me if you need expedited repo perms.

Sam (DevEx): +1 on sticky list. I'll add a short CLI snippet to get token && repo access quickly. Also will volunteer to be infra contact for first-week onboarding.

it-setup-bot: Ticket created: #IT-74821 — "Manager laptop + initial access". ETA: 3 business days.

Alex M: Thanks, this looks actionable. A couple of small asks: please include the on-call rota link and a quick note on how paging works (escalation steps). Also add a checkbox for 'check telemetry dashboards' (Datadog).

Priya: Will update checklist with Alex's asks and post final version here + Confluence link. Will also include a short one-paragraph note managers can paste into the welcome email. :thumbsup:

Nina (People Ops): Perfect — thanks everyone. Priya, if you can post the final version before EOD Fri that'd be ideal so hiring team can attach it to the offer timeline.

Priya: Will do.
